text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa and I have come to a shrine for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hm. ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Por supuesto! I'm here to take on a challenge from the gods!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru told me if you can make it from the torii gate to that tree with your eyes closed, your dreams will come true!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So basically…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The gods have issued me this challenge, and I shall face it head on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm positive!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course, I will be the one to fulfill my dream and become the world's strongest! I don't need the gods for that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But there's no way I'm gonna pass up a challenge! I've got a reputation, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa puts a blindfold over her mask and slowly starts walking…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I hit something… This feels like…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hurra! I made it to the tree!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Invincible, unbeatable—El's unstoppable! Challenge conquered!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: However, this should make my dreams extra certain to come true!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's sealed and stamped by the gods! No one can stop me now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa seems like she's in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get started…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa bumps into a tree and removes her blindfold so quickly her mask comes off with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooshhh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Agh! My mask!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To make matters worse, El Condor Pasa's mask is blown away by the wind.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: M-my mask! Waaait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this is punishment for treating a challenge from the gods like a game…
